versions.description_html:
Demystify Microsoft 365 licensing. Learn how business and enterprise plans, E3 vs E5, add-ons, and Copilot fit together without the confusion.

Microsoft 365 licensing isn't as complicated as the price sheet makes it look. Underneath all those tiers, there are really just two layers to understand.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a license really is
  • Business plans and Enterprise plans
  • E3 versus E5
  • The add-on layer
  • Where Copilot fits
  • How licenses get assigned
  • The overlap trap
  • Staying clean
  • The short version

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Licensing, Security & Management: Making Microsoft 365 Defender and Intune Work Together with Videsh Chavan
  • Beyond Copilot: Building Enterprise AI Agents That Actually Work with Copilot Studio with Manpreet Singh [MVP-MCT]
  • More Microsoft 365 episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Microsoft 365: the most-listened episodes
